bio.text: Eli Crane, born and raised in Arizona, is the U.S. Representative for Arizona's Second Congressional District.

A week after the September 11 attacks he left the University of Arizona in his senior year to enlist in the U.S. Navy, and over 13 years of service he deployed five times, three of them with SEAL Team 3.
In 2012 he and his wife co-founded a veteran-owned company making bottle openers from shell casings, which they sold in 2022.
